title: Communications Provider Messages Readability Cleanup

reasons: Fresh screenshots show the Communications subtab rail clipped on mobile.
The Provider Messages empty card is a large bright panel inside the One Time dark shell.
The route should stay read-only/no-send while the visible message lane becomes easier to scan.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time Communications Provider Messages route feel even and loaded by fixing the clipped communications tabs and the oversized bright empty message panel.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No message creation, contact communication creation, provider announcement, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, campaign, template, bot action, API, contact, route access, or helper behavior change.
No external send, publish, upload, payment, access grant, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, account, external CRM write, raw private evidence, or secret exposure.

affected_surfaces: One Time Operations Communications Provider Messages route

inspection_targets: public/css/one-time-operations.css One Time Operations route overrides
known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: The mobile Communications subtab rail cuts off labels after Student Messages.
The Provider Messages empty state is a bright, tall card that does not match the One Time dark route treatment.
The route lacks a narrow marker for scoped Communications-only One Time CSS.

expanded_phrases.clean: The Provider Messages lane should render as a compact route surface with readable tabs and an empty message state that fits the One Time admin shell.
expanded_phrases.even: The Communications heading, subtab rail, Provider Messages panel, and no-message state should use consistent spacing, contrast, and containment.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: After Operations data loads, the provider-message lane should immediately show a readable route title, contained tabs, and a no-message state that does not dominate the screen.
expanded_phrases.communications: For this packet, communications means read-only local Operations message-lane presentation only. It does not send, draft, create, import, sync, or mutate communication records.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The communications route remains a first-party BNA Operations provider-readiness view scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

requirements.statement: Fix One Time Communications Provider Messages readability so the Communications subtab rail is contained and the provider-message empty state is proportionate and readable.
requirements.expected_result: Desktop and mobile Communications Provider Messages screenshots show wrapped/contained tabs, a readable route heading, and a compact dark no-message state with no horizontal overflow.
acceptance_criteria: The Communications route has a scoped One Time route marker for CSS targeting.
The One Time Communications top filter rail wraps or contains all tabs on desktop and mobile without clipping labels.
The Provider Messages panel, count, and no-message copy are readable in the One Time dark theme.
The no-message empty state is visually quiet and proportionate to the Communications content.
Message, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, bot, API, contact, action registry, route access, and external-provider guardrails are unchanged.

criteria: Raw source and broad UI cleanup register exist for RAW-20260702-008.
Current screenshot evidence shows the communications tab clipping and empty-card readability defects.
The likely fix is scoped to route marker markup and One Time Operations CSS overrides.
No email, WhatsApp, Telegram, contact, campaign, bot, external provider, credential, account, privacy, or legal/financial decision is required for local visual implementation.
